user.title: Utility portal account
user.description: Sign in with the account you use on the web portal of your utility. The login form is detected automatically; only fill in the advanced fields if that fails.

data_description.base_url: For customers of Regio Energie Solothurn: https://okp.regioenergie.ch
data_description.username: On okp.regioenergie.ch this is the e-mail address you sign in with.
data_description.login_url: Full address of the login page, if it is not found automatically.
data_description.username_field: Name of the username input in the login form.
data_description.password_field: Name of the password input in the login form.

meter_type.title: What does the meter measure?
meter_type.description: The unit and the price on the next screen follow from this. Electricity and water are tested; gas and district heating are not - please report back if they work for you.

meter_details.title: Add meter
meter_details.description:
The price is optional and given in {currency} per {unit}. Enter one and the integration imports a second statistic with the costs, which the energy dashboard accepts as "a statistic tracking total costs". For water, add the water and the wastewater price together.

After setup, up to two years of history are imported in the background.

data_description.name: Used for the statistic name, e.g. Electricity or Water.
data_description.meter_number: Listed in the portal under Lastgang, on okp.regioenergie.ch at /de/services/lastgang.php.
data_description.unit: Must match the unit the portal exports.
data_description.obis_code: Leave at 1-1:1.29.0 unless the portal uses a different code.
data_description.export_type: Leave at WirkBezug unless the portal uses a different one.
data_description.price: Also prices the imported history. Price changes per month are added afterwards under Configure > Prices.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the stored credentials for {username}.

reconfigure.title: Portal account
reconfigure.description: Change the portal address, the account or the login details. The meters and their statistics stay as they are.

meter_type.title: What does the meter measure?
meter_type.description: The unit and the price on the next screen follow from this. Electricity and water are tested; gas and district heating are not - please report back if they work for you.

meter_details.title: Meter
meter_details.description:
The price is optional and given in {currency} per {unit}; prices that change over time are managed under Prices. A new meter gets its history imported in the background.

Renaming a meter keeps its statistics where they are. The unit of an existing meter cannot be changed, because its history is stored in it.

data_description.unit: Must match the unit the portal exports.
data_description.obis_code: Leave at 1-1:1.29.0 unless the portal uses a different code.
data_description.export_type: Leave at WirkBezug unless the portal uses a different one.
data_description.price: Also prices the imported history. Price changes per month are added afterwards under Configure > Prices.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Pick the meter whose prices you want to change.

price_menu.title: Prices of {meter}

price_add.title: Add price
price_add.description: Price in {unit_label}. An entry for the same month is replaced.

data_description.valid_from: Only the month counts; the price applies from the first of that month.

remove_meter.title: Remove meter
remove_meter.description: Removed meters are no longer polled.

data_description.delete_history: Removes the consumption and cost history of these meters from Home Assistant. This cannot be undone.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: The portal publishes new values every 15 minutes. Each poll reads the last two days.
data_description.days_to_fetch: Once a day this many days are read again, to pick up values the utility corrects afterwards.
data_description.history_days: How far back a newly added meter is imported. 0 imports no history.

meter_failed.description:

Check the meter under the integration options. This message disappears once an import succeeds again.
